biggest_catch: You only get the instant discount by buying through a participating provider — your own contractor or an already-installed system does not qualify unless you call MidAmerican first.
catches: Instant discounts are only available through participating Instant Discounts providers; the discount is deducted from the purchase price automatically.
If your contractor is not on the provider list, or you already installed the system, you must contact MidAmerican (877-932-0616) — terms may differ.
Instant discounts cannot be combined with any other rebate or incentive program, including prescriptive rebates.
Equipment must be purchased, installed, and operating between January 1 and December 31, 2026.
MidAmerican must provide the primary electricity or natural gas to the equipment.
The equipment purchase is a condition, not an upfront fee.

c3.evidence: No enrollment fee; equipment purchase is a purchase condition.

c4.evidence: Discount is automatically deducted from the purchase price at a participating provider — instant, no waiting period.

eligibility: Iowa/Illinois MidAmerican customer buying through a participating Instant Discounts provider. MidAmerican must provide the primary electricity or natural gas to the equipment. Equipment purchased, installed, and operating Jan 1–Dec 31, 2026.
notes: Verified on the official MidAmerican Energy page 2026-09-22. Discount is point-of-sale through the distributor/provider network — no paperwork.

steps: Use MidAmerican's provider search tool (or call 877-932-0616) to find a participating Instant Discounts provider near you.
Ask your HVAC contractor whether they participate in MidAmerican Instant Discounts before you buy.
Buy the qualifying equipment (heat pump, central AC, ductless, geothermal, or heat-pump water heater) through that provider.
The discount is automatically deducted from your purchase price — no rebate form needed.
timing: Instant — the discount is deducted from the purchase price at the participating provider; no application or waiting period.
